NAME: shop
LAST DEPLOYED: Fri Oct 10 07:55:12 2026
NAMESPACE: shop
STATUS: failed
REVISION: 12
TEST SUITE: None
NOTES:
  1. Get the application URL by running these commands:
    export POD_NAME=$(kubectl get pods --namespace shop -l "app.kubernetes.io/name=shop" -o jsonpath="{.items[0].metadata.name}")
    export CONTAINER_PORT=$(kubectl get pod --namespace shop $POD_NAME -o jsonpath="{.spec.containers[0].ports[0].containerPort}")
    echo "Visit http://127.0.0.1:8080 to use your application"
    kubectl --namespace shop port-forward $POD_NAME 8080:$CONTAINER_PORT
  
  2. Database migrations run as a pre-upgrade hook. Check them with:
    kubectl logs -n shop job/shop-migrate
  
  3. To scale workers:
    helm upgrade shop ./chart --set worker.replicas=5
  
  4. Monitoring dashboards are available at:
    https://grafana.example.com/d/shop
  
  5. Troubleshooting:
    - Check pod status: kubectl get pods -n shop
    - Check events: kubectl get events -n shop --sort-by=.lastTimestamp
    - Check logs: kubectl logs -n shop deploy/web
  
  6. Upgrading notes:
    Version 2.x renamed values: web.image -> image.web, worker.image -> image.worker
